sections.text: We will establish suitable entry conditions and identify reachable areas of the release. A dirty covering can hold liquid in low folds or hide contact underneath. Pumping above it alone will not be described as cleanup of the ground beneath.

sections.title: Remove trapped waste and treat accessible components
sections.text: Specified contaminated covering and debris will be contained for disposal, with reachable wastewater collected using appropriate equipment and arrangements. Retained building surfaces will have soil and residue physically removed before suitable disinfection. Ground material requiring additional treatment will receive its own scoped decision.

sections.title: Check the underside before replacing layers
sections.text: Accessible joists and subfloor will be evaluated for moisture and dried where suitable. Ongoing discharge needs source correction, while inaccessible contact remains an explicit limitation. New ground covering or insulation follows the resolved cleanup and repair condition rather than concealing it.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/glenn-heights.estimate: The scope will distinguish wastewater collection, covering removal and any affected ground treatment. Replacement materials and plumbing repair remain separate tasks.
